blurb: Guests fish for salmon and rainbow trout on the Little Susitna River, which offers over 60 miles of fishable water. The river is calm, slow-moving, and shallow, suitable for jet boat travel and wading. Trips include all essentials and provide opportunities to see wildlife such as moose, eagles, waterfowl, and bears.
